ok.de: Nach Not until am Anfang steht did vor dem Subjekt, danach die Grundform begin.
ok.en: After Not until at the start, did stands before the subject, then the base form begin.

wrong.de: had würde die 3. Form verlangen, hier folgt aber begin.
wrong.en: had would need the participle, but begin follows here.

wrong.de: Das Präsens does passt nicht zu was signed in der Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: The present does does not fit was signed in the past.

items.text: Not until the contract was signed ___ the technical team begin its preparation.

ok.de: Nach So complex steht das Verb vor dem Subjekt: So complex was the contract that …
ok.en: After So complex the verb stands before the subject: So complex was the contract that …

wrong.de: Is passt nicht zu needed in der Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: Is does not fit needed in the past.

wrong.de: Had ist hier kein Vollverb. Es fehlt die 3. Form.
wrong.en: Had is not a main verb here. The participle is missing.

wrong.de: Did braucht eine Grundform danach, hier fehlt sie.
wrong.en: Did needs a base form after it, which is missing here.

items.text: So complex ___ the contract that even the lawyers needed two weeks to read it.

ok.de: One ersetzt das Nomen report, damit es nicht wiederholt wird.
ok.en: One replaces the noun report so that it is not repeated.

wrong.de: It ersetzt keinen Teil einer Nominalgruppe nach einem Adjektiv.
wrong.en: It does not replace part of a noun phrase after an adjective.

wrong.de: Ones ist Plural, aber a shorter steht im Singular.
wrong.en: Ones is plural, but a shorter is singular.

wrong.de: That passt nicht hinter a shorter.
wrong.en: That does not fit after a shorter.

items.text: The previous report was too long, so please write a shorter ___.

ok.de: Die Kollegen sind beteiligt: Passiv braucht die 3. Form involved direkt hinter dem Nomen.
ok.en: The colleagues are involved: the passive needs the past participle involved right after the noun.

wrong.de: Hinter dem Nomen steht ein Partizip, keine Grundform.
wrong.en: A participle follows the noun, not a base form.

wrong.de: Involving wäre aktiv: die Kollegen würden etwas beteiligen.
wrong.en: Involving would be active: the colleagues would involve something.

wrong.de: To involved ist keine gültige Form.
wrong.en: To involved is not a valid form.

items.text: Please contact all colleagues ___ in the data migration before Friday.

ok.de: Nach hope steht not für den verneinten Gedanken: I hope not.
ok.en: After hope, not stands for the negative thought: I hope not.

wrong.en: “no” does not fit here. The word needed is “not”.
“nor” does not fit here. The word needed is “not”.
“never” does not fit here. The word needed is “not”.

items.text: Are the results final? I hope ___, because we still want to correct two figures.

ok.de: Nach as bleibt die normale Stellung: Surprising as it is.
ok.en: After as the normal order stays: Surprising as it is.

items.text: Surprising as is it, the cheaper tool is also the more reliable one.

ok.de: Nach Little am Satzanfang steht did vor dem Subjekt: Little did the board realize.
ok.en: After Little at the start, did stands before the subject: Little did the board realize.

wrong.de: Nach Little kommt did vor the board.
wrong.en: After Little, did comes before the board.

items.lead: The board did not realize how serious the problem was.
items.after: realize how serious the problem was.

ok.de: the first person to complete. Nach first steht to + Grundform.
ok.en: the first person to complete. After first comes to + base form.

wrong.de: Nach first person steht to + Grundform, kein who.
wrong.en: After first person comes to + base form, no who.

items.lead: Nobody in our department completed the certification before Dana did.
items.after: complete the certification in our department.
